tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Warm paper; every app starts here.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, buttons at rest (secondary).

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, kbd, inline code, meter tracks, drop zone at rest. Darker than surface in light, lighter in dark. Text on it: ink, ink-muted only.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code blocks and the CodeArea editor ground. All syn-* colors are 4.5:1+ on it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Soft-variant card borders, row dividers, hairline rules. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Soft-variant control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, pills). 3:1+ on bg, surface, code-bg.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on bg, surface, surface-sunk, code-bg (15:1+). Hard-variant borders and offset shadows.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hosts, captions, helper text, axis labels, on bg, surface, surface-sunk (6.2:1+).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, primary button fill, focus ring, selected pill, chart-1. Text-safe on bg, surface, surface-sunk (6.5:1+).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered links and primary buttons.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, drop zone while dragging over, info badge ground.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (7.6:1).

tokens.name: pop-red
tokens.usage: Pop fill: cover blocks, header bands, the danger button fill. Text on it: on-pop.

tokens.name: pop-yellow
tokens.usage: Pop fill: cover blocks, callouts, warn banner. Text on it: on-pop.

tokens.name: pop-mint
tokens.usage: Pop fill: cover blocks, the all-clear banner on a status page. Text on it: on-pop.

tokens.name: on-pop
tokens.usage: Text and icons on pop-red (5.9:1), pop-yellow (12.6:1), pop-mint (9.9:1).

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Highlighted text (<mark>), search hits. Ink on it.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy / up / passed. Always with the status-ok icon and a word. On bg, surface, ok-tint.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the ok badge and healthy uptime cells.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Degraded / slow / expiring. Always with status-warn and a word. On bg, surface, warn-tint.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the warn badge.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Down / failed / error text and borders. Always with status-down and a word. On bg, surface, down-tint.

tokens.name: down-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the down badge and error inputs' helper row.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational / maintenance notices, with status-info or status-maint.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the info badge.

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: No data / paused / unknown, with status-unknown or status-paused.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords, YAML keys, shell builtins.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Strings.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Numbers, booleans, constants.

tokens.name: syn-function
tokens.usage: Function and command names.

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Types, tags, anchors.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Comments, italic.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First series.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series. Marks only (3.6:1+), never text.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Baselines, previous period, dashed.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series. Marks only.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and axis rules.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Always-dark ground in both themes: video stage, ink tiles and charts, ink toasts, lightbox. Text on it: on-night.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text and icons on night (17.4:1).

tokens.name: on-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, axes and legends on a night ground (8.7:1).

tokens.name: ink-line
tokens.usage: Gridlines on a night ground. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink-band
tokens.usage: Highlighted ranges in a chart on a night ground.

tokens.name: term-red
tokens.usage: Terminal red on night: errors, failed steps (7.3:1).

tokens.name: term-green
tokens.usage: Terminal green on night: success, added (9.7:1).

tokens.name: term-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal yellow on night: warnings (10.0:1).

tokens.name: term-blue
tokens.usage: Terminal blue on night: info, paths (7.4:1).

tokens.name: term-magenta
tokens.usage: Terminal magenta on night (8.8:1).

tokens.name: term-cyan
tokens.usage: Terminal cyan on night (10.2:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: App name on a landing or status page. One per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Snapshots run nightly at 03:00 and are pruned after thirty days.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI copy: table cells with words, card descriptions, list items.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: Captions, helper text, footnotes, empty states.
styles.sample: No incidents in the last 90 days.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, inputs, pills, badges, tabs, menu items.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, hosts, ports, paths, IDs, table numbers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: field labels, panel eyebrows, axis titles, table headers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, control vertical padding, pill horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (dense), grid gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between stacked cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections, page gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of page to first heading; between major regions.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Every corner in the hard variant.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Soft: badges, kbd, inline code, uptime cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Soft: buttons, inputs, code blocks, diagram nodes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Soft: cards, panels, drop zones, cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Soft: pills and the status dot.

tokens.name: shadow-soft-sm
tokens.usage: Soft: buttons, inputs, pills at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-soft-md
tokens.usage: Soft: cards and panels.

tokens.name: shadow-soft-lg
tokens.usage: Soft: popovers, hovered cards, the drop zone while dragging.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-sm
tokens.usage: Hard: buttons, pills at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-md
tokens.usage: Hard: cards and panels.

tokens.name: shadow-hard-lg
tokens.usage: Hard: popovers, the drop zone while dragging.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed fields: inputs, code areas, kbd (both variants).

tokens.name: stroke-1
tokens.usage: Borders and hairline rules.

tokens.name: stroke-2
tokens.usage: Focus ring, selected state, hard-variant control borders.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Button and input height.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, pills.

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of prose.

tokens.name: size-page
tokens.usage: Max width of an app page.
